biggest_catch: Your bet is at risk: you pay up front (commonly ~$40), miss one weekly step goal and you are eliminated with your buy-in staying in the pot — winners split what remains after StepBet's 15% cut, and this is not income.
catches: Pay the bet up front to join; commonly ~$40 depending on the game.
Goals are personalized from your tracker history (active + stretch/power days); miss a weekly goal and you are out — your money funds the winners' pot.
StepBet retains 15% of the gross pot (per its own FAQ); winners split the remainder.
Payouts are processed through PayPal only (per FAQ) — winnings land as StepBet points first, redeemable or payable out.
In high-completion games, winners mostly get their own bet back — profit requires enough other players to fail.
This is not income — it is a conditional prize for hitting step goals.

steps: Download the StepBet app and connect your activity tracker.
Let StepBet calculate your personalized active/stretch step goals from your history.
Join a game and pay the bet up front (commonly ~$40 via PayPal or prior winnings).
Hit your required active/stretch days every week (the first week is usually a warm-up).
Complete the full game without missing a weekly goal to stay eligible.
Split the pot (minus StepBet's 15%) with the other winners; request payout via PayPal.
